headline: Executive order aims to update how the federal government sends and receives money.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs changes to modernize payments going into and out of the federal government's main account, held by the Treasury. No summary was provided, so the specific methods, rules, and exceptions are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People who receive money from the federal government, such as benefits or tax refunds
who_it_affects.how: The way these payments are sent to them may change.

who_it_affects.group: People and businesses who pay money to the federal government, such as taxes or fees
who_it_affects.how: The way they make these payments may change.
They may need to update their payment systems and processes.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 25, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the provided material.
